title: Extraction shaft under the Queen's Chamber removed product solution from the Great Pyramid
summary: Jeffrey tells of Extraction shaft under the Queen's Chamber removed product solution from the Great Pyramid, about an unknown time at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Queen's Chamber, Great Pyramid, Giza, Egypt

tellings.quote: which I've shown it's part of the extraction shaft system that was used to remove the product solution from the Great Pyramid.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes a theory from his own book about the Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt. He says a shaft under the Queen's Chamber, one of the rooms inside the pyramid, was part of a system of extraction shafts used to drain out a liquid product the pyramid made. If he is right, the pyramid was not just a tomb but a kind of working machine.
